content.json:
# SOC Lab Overview
Incidents, how quickly they were raised, which rules have fired, automated containment and log delay. Use the time range below to scope every chart.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize Incidents = count() by Severity
| order by Incidents desc
content.title: Incidents by severity

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize Incidents = count() by Title
| order by Incidents desc
content.title: Incidents by rule

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| summarize Incidents = count() by bin(CreatedTime, 1d), Severity
content.title: Incidents per day

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, Title), FirstActivityTime = min(FirstActivityTime), CreatedTime = min(CreatedTime) by IncidentNumber
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| extend MinutesToIncident = round(datetime_diff('second', CreatedTime, FirstActivityTime) / 60.0, 1)
| where MinutesToIncident >= 0
| summarize Incidents = count(), Median = round(percentile(MinutesToIncident, 50), 1), Slowest = max(MinutesToIncident) by Rule = Title
| order by Median desc
content.title: Minutes from first activity to incident, by rule
content.noDataMessage: No incidents in this time range.

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where ProviderName == 'ASI Scheduled Alerts'
| summarize Alerts = count(), LastFired = max(TimeGenerated) by Rule = AlertName, Severity = AlertSeverity
| order by LastFired desc
content.title: Rules that have fired
content.noDataMessage: No rule has fired in this time range.

content.query:
AzureActivity
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where tolower(_ResourceId) endswith '/securityrules/autoblock-attackers'
| where ActivityStatusValue =~ 'Success'
| extend Action = iff(OperationNameValue endswith 'DELETE' or OperationNameValue endswith 'delete', 'Block removed', 'Block written'), By = iff(Caller contains '@', 'A person', 'Automation'), NSG = tostring(split(_ResourceId, '/')[8])
| project TimeGenerated, Action, By, NSG
| order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Automatic containment: changes to the AutoBlock-Attackers rule
content.noDataMessage: No blocks were written or removed in this time range.

content.query:
union SecurityEvent, Event
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| extend DelayMinutes = datetime_diff('second', ingestion_time(), TimeGenerated) / 60.0
| summarize Events = count(), Median = round(percentile(DelayMinutes, 50), 1), P95 = round(percentile(DelayMinutes, 95), 1), Worst = round(max(DelayMinutes), 1) by Computer, Table = Type
| order by Worst desc
content.title: Log delay in minutes (time from event to arrival in the workspace)
content.noDataMessage: No events in this time range.

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where CreatedTime {TimeRange}
| project Incident = IncidentNumber, Rule = Title, Severity, Status, Classification, Created = CreatedTime
| order by Incident desc
content.title: Incidents
